tips.text: Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra relics for Nova Prime Chassis; it is the Rare part and the bottleneck.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine Uncommon and Rare relics to Radiant and leave Common ones Intact, since Radiant lowers their odds.
Crack Radiant relics in a radshare so the Rare part rolls more often.
